title: GLG Survey: Half of APAC Business Leaders Shifting Focus Away from U.S. Amid Tariffs
summary: GLG surveyed 300+ senior APAC executives on U.S. tariff impacts. Key findings: 50% shifted market focus away from the U.S., 25%+ raised prices or reduced headcount, and 70% of exporters report significant challenges from trade instability, especially in automotive and aerospace.
